title: MyCleans Beta Tester Terms
summaryNote: This summary is to help you. The full terms below are what count.
summary: The beta is an early version of MyCleans. It will have bugs, and things may change or break.
It's free to use during the beta.
If you're accepted and you follow these terms, you get 2 years of free premium access, starting on the day we launch MyCleans officially.
We'd love your honest feedback, and we can use it to improve MyCleans.
Your content stays yours. We look after your information as set out in our Privacy Policy.
MyCleans is a platform. You and the other cleaner or host will deal with each other directly.
Either of you can end your participation at any time.

items.text: These terms are an agreement between you and MissJaneVentures Pty Ltd ACN 671838190 ("MyCleans", "we", "us", "our"). They apply to your participation in the MyCleans beta programme (the "Beta").
You accept these terms when you apply for the Beta, tick the box to say you agree, or use the Beta, whichever happens first. If you don't agree, please don't apply or use the Beta.
In these terms:
sub: "Service" means the MyCleans web app and related services.
"Beta Period" means the period when we run the Beta. We expect it to start on or around 30 November 2026 and run for about two months.
"Official Launch Date" means the date we first make the Service generally available to the public, as we announce it.
"Premium" means the paid subscription tier of the Service as it exists from time to time, including its features.
"Content" means anything you upload or enter into the Beta, including job details, reports, photos, messages, invoices and property information.

items.text: The Beta is an early, pre-release version of the Service. It isn't the final product. It may contain errors, be unavailable at times, and have features that change or are removed without notice.
We can start, extend, shorten, pause or end the Beta at any time. We'll try to give you notice, but we don't have to.
We have tentatively set an Official Launch Date but that may change and we make no promises as to the official launch date.
You must be at least 18 years old and be a professional cleaner or a self-managing short-stay host based in Australia.
You must give us accurate information when you apply and keep it up to date.
Applying doesn't guarantee you a place. We choose who joins the Beta, and when. We can decline or remove anyone.
You can have one Beta account, for yourself or your business. If you apply for a business, you confirm you're authorised to do so.
We hope you'll use the Beta on real jobs and tell us what works and what doesn't.
You must use the Beta lawfully and keep your login details secure. You're responsible for what happens under your account.
You must not:
sub: (a) copy, reverse-engineer or try to get at the source code of the Service;
(b) scrape, overload, interfere with, or try to break the Service or its security;
(d) pretend to be someone else or give false information;
(e) use the Beta to harass or harm others, or for anything unlawful; or

items.text: You must also follow the terms of other platforms and services you use alongside the Beta, such as booking platforms and payment providers.
You won't be charged to take part in the Beta. We won't ask for payment details to join it, other than where needed to set up payments between you and other users, if that feature is available.
We decide which features are included in the Beta, including which Premium features.
If we accept you into the Beta and you comply with these terms, we will give you 2 years (24 months) of free access to Premium, starting on the Official Launch Date (the "Premium Reward").
During the Premium Reward you'll have the same access as a paying Premium subscriber has from time to time. What Premium includes may change over time.
To receive the Premium Reward, you must have created an account and used the Beta at least 1 time and given us feedback at least 1 time during the Beta Period.
We'll apply the Premium Reward to the email address or account you used in the Beta.

When the 2 years end, we'll tell you at least 30 days before. We won't start charging you unless you choose to subscribe to Premium. If you don't subscribe, you can keep using the free version of the Service, to the extent we offer one.
The Premium Reward:
sub: (a) is personal to you and can't be transferred or sold;
(b) has no cash value and can't be exchanged for money;
(c) is limited to one per person or business; and
(d) can't be combined with other offers unless we say so.

items.text: If we decide not to launch the Service publicly, or we close the Service before the Official Launch Date, the Premium Reward ends and we won't owe you anything for it. We'll tell you if that happens.
We can withdraw the Premium Reward if you breach these terms or act fraudulently, for example by creating fake accounts.

You promise that you have the right to upload your Content, and that it doesn't break the law or anyone's rights.

Be careful with other people's information. Don't upload more personal information about guests, clients or other people than you need. Don't upload photos of people without their consent. Share things like addresses and access details only with the person who needs them.
The Beta may lose or reset data. Keep your own copies of anything important. We'll try to keep your data when the Beta moves to the Official Launch, but we can't promise it.

We collect and use your personal information (such as your name, email, role and how you use the Beta) to run the Beta and improve the Service, as set out in our Privacy Policy at www.mycleans.com.au/privacypolicy. You agree we can email you about the Beta and the Official Launch, for example invitations, updates and requests for feedback. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time. We may still send you essential messages about your account or the Beta.
We won't publish your name, business name, photo or comments (for example as a testimonial) without your permission.
"Feedback" means any comments, ideas, bug reports or suggestions you give us about the Beta or the Service, including through the "Suggest a feature" form.

You give us a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to use your Feedback however we like, including to improve the Service and develop new features, without paying or crediting you. We don't have to act on any Feedback.
Don't include other people's personal or confidential information in your Feedback.

The Beta, including unreleased features, screens and plans, is confidential. Don't share screenshots, recordings or details of the Beta publicly without our written permission, except to say that you're a beta tester.

Don't share other users' information or your login details. If you find a security problem, tell us privately at hello@mycleans.com.au and give us reasonable time to fix it before you tell anyone else.

If payments are available in the Beta, they're processed by our payment provider under its terms. We aren't a bank or payment provider. You're responsible for any tax, GST and invoicing obligations that apply to you. We don't give tax or legal advice.

sections.heading: 14. Ending the Beta or your participation

items.text: You can leave the Beta at any time by emailing us at hello@mycleans.com.au
We can suspend or end your participation at any time, for example if you breach these terms, misuse the Service, or we end the Beta.
When your participation or the Beta ends, your access to the Beta ends, unless we move you to the launched Service. Where we reasonably can, we'll give you 14 days to export your Content.
If we end your participation because you breached these terms, you lose the Premium Reward. If you choose to leave the Beta, you also lose the Premium Reward.
Sections that by their nature should continue after the Beta ends (for example 6, 7, 9, 12, 13 and 16) continue to apply.

We may update these terms. If a change matters, we'll email you at least 14 days before it takes effect, unless we need to make it sooner for legal or security reasons. If you don't agree, you can leave the Beta.
We won't change these terms in a way that reduces the Premium Reward for people we've already accepted, except where the law requires it.
These terms, together with our Privacy Policy and any invitation we send you, are the entire agreement between us about the Beta.
These terms are governed by the laws of Queensland, Australia, and both of us submit to the courts of Australia.
If any part of these terms can't be enforced, the rest still applies.
If we don't enforce a right straight away, we haven't given it up.
You can't transfer your rights under these terms to anyone else. We may transfer ours if we sell or restructure the business.
We can give you notices by email at the address you gave us.
Nothing in these terms makes either of us the employee, partner or agent of the other.
You can accept these terms electronically.
Questions about these terms? Email hello@mycleans.com.au
